interventions.detail: README's paddlepaddle index https://mirror.baidu.com/pypi/simple returns 403; installed paddlepaddle==3.3.1 from PyPI
Python 3.12 fails (onnxoptimizer==0.3.13 via paddle2onnx has no cp312 wheel, needs cmake); used uv-managed Python 3.10
webrtcvad needs Python headers; avoided by using uv-managed Python 3.10 which ships them (python3-dev otherwise)
setuptools and pip must be in the env: paddle imports setuptools and paddlenlp imports pip at runtime
datasets<3 (newer datasets requires newer huggingface_hub than paddlenlp tolerates)
paddlespeech_ctcdecoders is pip-installed at ASR runtime; installed it up front
